entities.summary: Víctor Manuel Ochoa Cadavid was a Colombian Catholic bishop, philosopher and academic. He was auxiliary bishop of Medellín (2006–2011), bishop of Málaga-Soatá (2011–2015), bishop of Cúcuta (2015–2020) and military ordinary of Colombia (2020–2025).

entities.summary: Víctor Manuel Ochoa Cadavid was a Colombian Catholic bishop, philosopher and academic. He was auxiliary bishop of Medellín (2006–2011), bishop of Málaga-Soatá (2011–2015), bishop of Cúcuta (2015–2020) and military ordinary of Colombia (2020–2025).
